target.statement: FE-GNN (C) test accuracy on Cora node classification (89.45 ± 0.22)

compute.basis: Cora is a small citation graph (2708 nodes, 1433 features); the model is a shallow linear GNN with polynomial order 3, so training 100 runs on CPU is feasible within an hour, though a GPU would speed it up.

title: Feature Expansion for Graph Neural Networks
